items.title: Cool Easter Furries
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Furries are back in town! Wear funky cool costumes while becoming best friends with the coolest animals in the city. You can also choose to be a normal teen that likes to dress up in cute disguises. Everything is possible when you just live your life the best way possible that fits you!

+ 1 free skin 
+ 12 furry-themed skins 
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Plant People
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Been stuck inside for ages? Well now you can feel like you're outside with these plant people! 

*10 plant people
*1 skin free

items.title: End Adventure
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
You've spent plenty of time in the overworld, and you've been to the Nether. How about we take an adventure to the End? 

*12 adventurers
*2 skins free

items.title: Drip Teens
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Whether you live in the big city or out in the suburbs; you can go about the place in style with these COOL teens! 

*12 cool teens
*2 skins free

items.title: Pirate Refuge
items.creator: Diluvian
items.description: Arrrhg! Hello mate, I hope you are doing well! This old pirate will tell you a secret, an island in the middle of the monster ocean, a safe places for all pirates in the world to travel long distances. Would you like to explore it too? It's called pirate refuge!

items.title: Dewy Days
items.creator: Zombeanie
items.description:
Spring has sprung right into action! For wonderful warm weather or even cold rainy days, there's an outfit (or animal) to match the occasion.
-10 unique skins
-by Ryleigh

items.title: Lucky Bubble Factory
items.creator: Piki Studios
items.description:
Like Lucky Blocks? Lucky Blocks have nothing on Lucky Bubbles! And where do you find Lucky Bubbles? A Lucky Bubble Factory! Make bubbles and pop them to get loot! Collect Lucky Bubbles that have the old Lucky Block feeling.

- 4 funky skins to vibe in the Factory
- Lucky Block style Lucky Bubbles!
- Races for Jetski's, cars, and elytra's
- Bubble helicopter with booster!

items.title: SKYBLOCK BUNDLE
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: SKYBLOCK BUNDLE has 6 maps in 1! 3 CHALLENGES, 2 ONE BLOCK, and 1 LUCKY BLOCK skyblock maps!

items.title: Skyblock Billionaire
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Skyblock Billionaire brings luxury flying cars to a skyblock challenge! Survive on islands in the sky and use limited blocks to beat a custom survival challenge.

items.title: Lucky Block Skyblock
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
A fun twist to a classic skyblock challenge! These lucky blocks can get you powerful loot that is hard to acquire or spawn equally powerful enemies to block your progress! These mysterious blocks spawn naturally or can be traded for!

+ Lucky blocks have positive and negative outcomes!

items.title: Rainbow Demons
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Long-awaited Rainbow Demons are now here! Pick one of 11 skin colorful demon skins and play along with your buddies! Be scary yet vibrant with these epic skins! 

- 11 skins
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from UniDesigns.

items.title: Malfunction 2.0
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
The famous Minecraft Skins Manufacturer AI (MSMAI) improved itself and created a bunch of new characters! Unfortunately, everything didn't go as planned: some bugs persist to create evils creatures among them, but the IT team is ready to fight them!

+ 64 IA-generated skins!
+ 16 classic IT skins!
- 2 free skins!
- By Pixelusion & Golimane

items.title: Rainbow Racers
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Rainbow Racers landed on the Overworld when the rainbow trail slipped and formed a portal to the unknown. They are in the process of finding a way out, but in the meantime, they want to have fun here.

- 18 cool racers skins
+ 1 free skin!
- By Pixelusion & Lostduckies

items.title: Time Travel
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Time Travels has just hit the Marketplace! A skin pack of time travelers who are hidden in different eras of humanity. Whether you want to become a caveman or a cyborg in your next role-playing game, this skin pack is really perfect for you!

- 10 time travelers skins
- Perfect for roleplay
- By Pixelusion and CubePlanet

items.title: Pizzas!
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Pizzas are taking over the world! Choose a pizza from the menu and embodies one of the funniest skins ever! But be careful that the other players don't eat you...
Bon appétit!

- 10 funny and tasty HD pizza-shaped skins!
- A unique looking design!
- Perfect to attract all eyes on you!
- By Pixelusion

items.title: Business Tycoons
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description: Meetings. Stocks. Money. These skins may look like all business, but they come with fun too! Be the best dressed of your crew! Includes many wealthy, powerful suits to wear!

items.title: Space Adventures HD
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description: Are you looking for out-of-this-world skins for your next adventure? Then look no further! Perfect for visiting new worlds with friends, you can choose to explore as humans or aliens!

items.title: Brick Heads
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
It’s time to stop beating your head against a brick wall, and let these characters do it for you!
These fifteen wildly creative skins bring that brick and mortar feel to any experience.
Check ‘em out! They’re thick as a… well, you know.

items.title: Anime High School
items.creator: House of How
items.description: When the new semester starts it’s more than cosplay, it’s a full otaku convention! Rumi and Kai get a slice of life as senpai bunny and Cairo-chan face off in a battle royale! Schedule your classes for drama, magic, and love with these 12 skins inspired by manga, anime, and Japanese pop culture!

items.title: Cartoon Cliques
items.creator: House of How
items.description: This is more than an after-school special: babysitters and preppy kids, jocks and overachievers, this is a whole ecosystem! Find where you belong among 15 social skins and bring your friends wherever you go: behind the gymnasium, in front of the classroom, at the record store and more!

items.title: Breakfast Binge
items.creator: House of How
items.description: It’s time to unbalance your breakfast in the direction of deliciousness! This buffet has bacon, eggs, and pancakes with maple syrup galore! Chocolate frosted doughnuts and jelly filled, classic poptarts and hot coffee to wash it all down! I hope you brought an appetite because this massive meal contains 10 essential skins & vitamins for a banquet breakfast about to burst!

items.title: Laser Robots
items.creator: House of How
items.description: These robots just received a radioactive upgrade: new and improved supersonic speeds plus laser technology! 15 neon-colored robot skins in all. These digital masterminds will leave you glowing electric!

items.title: ZOMBIE APOCALYPSE
items.creator: SNDBX
items.description:
Zombies are attacking YOUR city! Survive the zombie waves alone or with friends. Fight wave after wave of increasingly deadly zombies and bosses with custom weapons.

+ Multiplayer & singleplayer
+ 9 UNIQUE zombies
+ 3 EPIC boss fights
+ 11 CUSTOM weapons
+ 3 FUN maps
+ 15 INTENSE waves
+ 3 difficulties
+ 3 skins + 2 free skins

items.title: Block Pets
items.creator: Starfish Studios
items.description:
Find and care for the adorable Block Pets! Discover them in every biome. Equip your pets with armor, saddles or swords and fight alongside them! Can you collect them all?

+ 200+ unique Block Pets
+ Over 30 themed furniture items
+ Includes cute Block Pets City 
+ 8x cute skins

! Only usable in world provided
